exercises: a single x-notes entry written as a bare string rather than an object
note: A bare string is the shorthand form. It carries no source of its own, so it takes the default grade `live`, meaning someone observed the service behave this way. A document written before grades existed must therefore render unchanged.

expected.assert: The bare string is read as a note with the default grade `live`, and is not skipped for lacking a `note` key.
The note is presented as an observation about the API, distinct from the operation's own description.
